probe.name: V2_dense_rank_pair
probe.sql:
SELECT timestamp,
       sum(tract_count) AS metadata_rows_count,
       max(model_count_per_row) AS model_count,
       sum(bldg_weight) AS units_count,
       sum(bs_elec * bldg_weight) AS elec_baseline,
       sum(up_elec * bldg_weight) AS elec_upgrade,
       sum((coalesce(bs_elec,0) - coalesce(up_elec,0)) * bldg_weight) AS elec_savings,
       sum(bs_gas * bldg_weight) AS gas_baseline,
       sum(up_gas * bldg_weight) AS gas_upgrade,
       sum((coalesce(bs_gas,0) - coalesce(up_gas,0)) * bldg_weight) AS gas_savings
FROM (
  SELECT ts_aggr.timestamp, ts_aggr.bs_elec, ts_aggr.up_elec, ts_aggr.bs_gas, ts_aggr.up_gas,
         bs_per_bldg.bldg_id, bs_per_bldg.tract_count, bs_per_bldg.bldg_weight,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ts_aggr.timestamp ORDER BY bs_per_bldg.bldg_id ASC) +
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ts_aggr.timestamp ORDER BY bs_per_bldg.bldg_id DESC) - 1
         AS model_count_per_row
  FROM (
  SELECT ts_flat.state, ts_flat.timestamp, ts_flat.bldg_id,
         sum(ts_flat.elec) FILTER (WHERE ts_flat.upgrade=0) AS bs_elec,
         sum(ts_flat.elec) FILTER (WHERE ts_flat.upgrade=1) AS up_elec,
         sum(ts_flat.gas) FILTER (WHERE ts_flat.upgrade=0) AS bs_gas,
         sum(ts_flat.gas) FILTER (WHERE ts_flat.upgrade=1) AS up_gas,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE ts_flat.upgrade=0) AS _inner_rows
  FROM (
    SELECT ts.state, ts.bldg_id, ts.upgrade,
           date_trunc('month', date_add('second', -900, ts.timestamp)) AS timestamp,
           ts."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption" AS elec,
           ts."out.natural_gas.total.energy_consumption" AS gas
    FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state AS ts
    WHERE ts.upgrade IN (0, 1) AND ts.state = 'CO'
      AND (ts.bldg_id, ts.state) IN (
        SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs
        WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1) AND bs.applicability=true AND bs.state = 'CO'
        GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs.state HAVING count(distinct(bs.upgrade))=1
      )
  ) AS ts_flat
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
) AS ts_aggr
  JOIN (
  SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs.state, sum(bs.weight) AS bldg_weight, count(*) AS tract_count
  FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade=0 AND bs.state='CO' GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs.state
) AS bs_per_bldg ON bs_per_bldg.bldg_id = ts_aggr.bldg_id AND bs_per_bldg.state = ts_aggr.state
) sub
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
